title: Protect strict-match NEXY systems from unrelated changes
scope: Record the previously strict-match subsystem set as protected in AI-CONTEXT.

claims_proofs.claim: 12 strict-match systems are protected from unrelated modification.

tests_results: No NEXY.AI source tests executed; governance-only AI-CONTEXT write.
changes: AI-CONTEXT governance record only. NEXY.AI source repository unchanged.
decisions: Protected systems may only change after authoritative spec change, proven regression, or unavoidable dependency/security need with impact/regression verification.
risks: Protection must not be interpreted as permanent truth across future HEADs without revalidation.
limits: Protection is snapshot-scoped and subsystem-scoped, not whole-repository release approval.
rollback: Revert the AI-CONTEXT commit(s) if the governance record is invalidated.
next_actions: Keep protected systems unchanged unless an allowed-change condition in the project constraint is proven.
